transcript: Speaker A: Spoken English start kijiye, full masti karke. Spoken English theek hai, karte hain. Ajeeb si cheez hai, demand acchi hai. Mere khyal se hai zaroorat. summary: Alakh Pandey highlights the high demand and necessity for spoken English, introducing the PW Talk app. The ad showcases key features like the RIVA AI partner, roleplay scenarios, and bite-sized video lessons. It ends with a call to action to download the app on Google Play.
